angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 676,916 km at 112.59 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.8816 +/- 0.0219 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12): 112.59 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.973 +/- 0.038 solar radii from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-277 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract): 676,916 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.974 +/- 0.053 solar masses from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-277 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5680 +/- 120 K from Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-277 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Thygesen et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-277 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-277.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.450, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-277 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.078 dex, from Thygesen et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-277 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.05061, from Thygesen et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-277 (pscomppars): age 4.9 Gyr, from Thygesen et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165..155T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/168/234/table10 (Flares & flaring stars from TESS & machine learning), column Prot: 7.35863 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-277 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.3 km/s, from Howard et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025ApJS..278...52H/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.973 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.344. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
